steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ with login 'admin' and password 'admin' (use the login form at /web/login). Then create a new customer contact named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with City set to 'Benchville' (Contacts app, create new contact, set name and city, save). Verify the contact is saved and report the contact's name and city as shown on the saved record. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

02-create: In Odoo (already signed in as admin), go to the Sales app and create a new quotation for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose the customer from the autocomplete dropdown so it is actually selected, not just typed). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (choose it from the product autocomplete dropdown so it is actually selected), with quantity 3. Let Odoo fill in the unit price automatically from the product. Save the quotation. Report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price Odoo filled in on the line, and (c) the Untaxed Amount the quotation shows. Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.

03-open: In Odoo Sales (already signed in as admin), there is an unsaved new quotation form for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with an open 'Configure your product' modal blocking it. Resolve this so the quotation ends up SAVED with exactly ONE order line: quantity 3 of a product chosen from the product autocomplete dropdown, with Odoo's auto-filled unit price. If clicking Cancel on the modal drops the line or the product keeps re-opening the configurator, pick a different product that does not trigger the configurator modal. Then click Save and verify the record is persisted (statusbar no longer 'New', a record id appears in the URL). Report: (a) the product name on the line, (b) the unit price, (c) the Untaxed Amount shown, and (d) confirmation the quotation is saved (e.g. its reference/name if shown). Do not wait for network idle; wait for concrete page state.
